appliedUpdates.description: Updated architecture.md Validator Strictness section to reflect auto-legacy fallback behavior: synthesizeWorkerResult now auto-enables legacy mode when exitCode===0 and files were changed, not just when explicit legacyMode option is passed.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: all injected worker context sections (library topics, project info, directory listings, dependency lists) should have size caps to prevent context bloat in large projects. The library system enforces MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH=2000, but project-info auto-detection (tsconfig, package.json, directory listing) has no such limits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature fix-worker-context-project-info adds buildProjectStructureSection and buildPackageInfoSection without size caps, while extensions/state/library.ts enforces MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH=2000 with truncation.
